Gradle Wrapper binary notice
============================

gradle-wrapper.jar is intentionally not fabricated in this generated project.
Before the first build and before GitHub publication, copy the complete Gradle Wrapper
from the official Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 / Forge 47.4.10 MDK:

  gradlew
  gradlew.bat
  gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar
  gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties

The properties file currently present here documents the expected Gradle 8.1.1 setup,
but the official MDK files are the source of truth and should replace it.
